fact: The Government of Liberia's REALISE Social Cash Transfer programme pays extremely poor families quarterly by MTN mobile money, with all transfers delivered digitally (REALISE Project, Government of Liberia).

The Liberia Household Social Registry, held by the Ministry of Gender, Children and Social Protection with over 442,000 poverty-ranked households, supplies the households enrolled into the Social Cash Transfer, per the REALISE Project.
Governor Saamoi says the IIPS pilot phase offers person-to-person and government-to-people real-time transactions, and that salaries, pensions and social transfers will be delivered through it.
CBL Directive 002/2025 says that from 27 October 2025 all Government of Liberia payments to beneficiaries by mobile money must be routed exclusively through NEPS/IIPS.
The directive names salaries, pensions, social benefits and other transfers as the government payments by mobile money routed through NEPS/IIPS.
The speaker says civil servants' salaries were pushed to wallets through the instant payment system, with government payments as its first use case.
FrontPage Africa says the IIPS pilot phase currently supports government-to-people transactions.
